## Checklist

- [ ] File sits in the correct folder and follows the `<subject>-<variant>[-<size>].<ext>` naming convention
- [ ] A vector master (SVG) is included for any logo, icon, or diagram
- [ ] SVGs have been run through `svgo`; PNGs through `oxipng`
- [ ] The folder's `README.md` table has been updated
- [ ] I have the right to publish this (no unpublished-paper figures, no participant data, no third-party assets without a compatible licence)
- [ ] Screenshots contain no identifying information
- [ ] `python3 scripts/check_assets.py` passes locally

## Logo changes only

- [ ] A Neurodesk maintainer has been tagged for sign-off
- [ ] `BRAND.md` updated if the palette or usage rules changed
